SearchResourcesResponse.description: A heterogeneous search projection whose items identify resources through typed references.

Notification.description: A read-only actor-specific projection of a durable notification record.

ListNotificationsResponse.description: A Kubernetes-style list of actor-visible Notification projections.

ListConnectorVersionsResponse.description: A Kubernetes-style list of connector generations.

ListRateLimitsResponse.description: A Kubernetes-style list of rate limits.

RequestEvent.description: An immutable, resource-shaped HTTP event projection; it is not a client-managed desired resource.

ListRequestEventsResponse.description: A paginated list of immutable RequestEvent projections.
